`enum GlFrameBufferFamily`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.capability` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlFrameBufferFamily.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/capability/GlFrameBufferFamily.java)<br/>

The family of framebuffer functions that an OpenGL context offers.

## Learn more

- [Capabilities and paths](/build/base-modules/opengl/#capabilities-and-paths)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`CORE`](#GlFrameBufferFamily-value-CORE) | The core functions of OpenGL 3.0 or `GL_ARB_framebuffer_object`. |
| [`EXT`](#GlFrameBufferFamily-value-EXT) | The functions of `GL_EXT_framebuffer_object`. |
| [`UNSUPPORTED`](#GlFrameBufferFamily-value-UNSUPPORTED) | No framebuffer object: JOID cannot draw on the context. |
